title: Spain's Economy Caught Between Strong Growth and a Cost-of-Living Squeeze · 18 Aug
keywords: Spain economy, inflation, cost of living, GDP growth, housing prices, euro area, Pedro Sánchez, Bank of Spain, energy prices, European recovery fund
notes: Spain's headline economic figures remain among the most resilient in the euro area, but a jump in inflation to 3.6% in July and soaring housing costs are undermining household confidence. The gap between macroeconomic performance and lived experience is sharpening a political fight over who benefits from growth. For policymakers in Madrid and Brussels alike, the tension between solid GDP numbers and mounting affordability pressures represents a test of economic credibility.
